scene.description: Close on the transition point in a short row of cut-paper browser-window cards, the last grey card giving way to the first cream card, which glows, a single navy paper step-edge marking the join between them.
scene.one_idea: building the skills that turn a beginner into a practising consultant

objects.state: unlit, positioned left, the last card before the transition
glowing from within, positioned right, the first card after the transition
objects.prop_definition: rounded rectangle of card stock, raised raised top strip cut from warm grey card, matte paper, never metal or gloss with slotted address bar and punched dots, recessed content panel

objects.state: marking the join between the grey card and the cream card

lighting.key: soft warm key light, upper left, 3000K to 3500K, roughly 40 degrees, large diffuser, soft gradual shadow edges
lighting.fill: weak cool fill from the right, about one quarter key strength
lighting.practical: single internal practical behind the cream card, glowing at #FDE7C8

camera.setup: B: straight-on macro, level or a few degrees above, close on the transition point so paper fibre and the step-edge are legible
camera.orientation: near-parallel to the cards' faces with a slight rotation so stack depth reads
camera.framing: approximately 30 to 40 degree field of view, close, layering and paper fibre legible

background.falloff: darker toward the top of the frame

composition_rules.focal_position: off centre, roughly on a third
composition_rules.physical_plausibility: every object must be able to stand, lean or lie as shown
composition_rules.one_focal_group: exactly one warm-lit focal group with a single light source: the cream card, lit
composition_rules.navy_group_rule: the navy element is one object, or repetitions of one identical object in one contiguous composition; never mixed navy objects
composition_rules.navy_range: subdued navy paper only, #1A2340 to #3F4A68; no vivid, emitted or periwinkle blue

negative: Google or browser or search-engine marks
more than one warm light source
more than one navy element group
